validity.recommendation: Correct EndState/Province and EndCountryOrArea to Minnesota / United States; the pipeline as proposed does not physically cross into Canada.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM records EndState/Province=Manitoba, EndCountryOrArea=Canada, EndPrefecture/District=Emerson-Franklin -- i.e. treats this as a US-Canada border-crossing line. Three independent, dated sources all place the physical terminus in northwestern Minnesota, US, not Canada: (1) WBI Energy's own spokesperson Laura Lueder, quoted on the record in the Pierce County Tribune (2020-02-21): 'Our proposal is to go from the Tioga area to northwestern Minnesota, which is near the Emerson natural gas hub. Our other large gas pipelines connect at that hub and then the gas moves from there to larger markets, such as Chicago.' -- i.e. WBI's own pipe ends in Minnesota near (not at/in) the Emerson hub; (2) EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook records State(s)=ND,MN, Beg_State=ND, End_State=MN, and Crosses State Border=Yes (a US interstate designation, not an international one) in every release 2020-03 through 2026-08; (3) offshore-technology.com's project profile states the pipeline 'will start in North Dakota (the US) and ends in Minnesota (the US).' A Federal Register full-text search for '"Tioga to Emerson"' returns zero documents (checked 2026-09-15 via the FederalRegister.gov API), consistent with no DOE/FECM Presidential Permit or FERC Section 3 export/import authorization ever having been sought for this project -- expected if it never crosses the international border. A Canada Energy Regulator site search for the same terms returned no usable results (client-rendered search page, inconclusive either way -- not relied on). The routes-repo geojson's easternmost vertex sits at (-97.208086, 49.005584), about 0.6 km north of the 49th parallel -- fractionally inside Manitoba -- which reads as an artifact of digitizing to the Emerson hub landmark itself rather than evidence the pipe crosses the border; 'Emerson' in the project's own name is the name of the interconnect hub it was designed to reach, not proof its pipe enters Canada. Recommend GEM's end-location cells be corrected to Minnesota/United States (EndPrefecture/District cleared, since 'Emerson-Franklin' is a Manitoba municipality that would no longer apply); no route-geometry replacement is proposed, only the attribute correction. Commodity classification is NOT in question: WBI's own spokesperson calls it 'a large interstate natural gas pipeline system,' EIA classifies it in the Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, and offshore-technology.com calls it 'the onshore gas pipeline' -- this is correctly tracked as gas, not NGL/crude, despite sitting in Bakken oil country.

Newest independent evidence: EIA's Oct 2024 release records the shift to On Hold (year_in_service_date blanked from the prior 2025 target); every EIA release since, through Aug 2026, keeps it On Hold -- no reversal. ShelvedYear=2024 is only ~2 years dormant as of this review (2026-09-15), under the dispatch brief's 'shelved >=4y -> cancelled' threshold, so verdict is 'confirm' (dormant, not yet cancellable) rather than 'stale'/'change' -- consistent with the brief's own instruction to use confirm when dormant but under the threshold.

summary: P2625 Tioga to Emerson Pipeline is a genuine, correctly-classified NATURAL GAS proposal (WBI Energy Transmission, Bakken-to-hub takeaway; not the NGL/crude projects common in this Bakken corridor) that stalled pre-FERC and is best read as shelved since Oct 2024, per EIA -- status_reviews verdict 'confirm' (evidence 2024-10; WBI's current site + MDU's FY2025 10-K corroborate by favoring a separate 'Bakken East Pipeline' instead; only ~2y dormant, below the 4y->cancelled threshold, so not yet 'stale'). Main finding: the sheet's EndState/Province=Manitoba/Canada is wrong -- WBI's own spokesperson, EIA (Crosses State Border=Yes), and offshore-technology.com all place the true terminus in northwestern Minnesota, US; staged as an attribution concern + corrected Location fill. 14 REFS_ADDED/REVERIFIED, 3 UNRESOLVED (Construction, Pressure, SegmentCost -- none of which this project ever reached), no cross-row leads on the 42-row roster.
